title: Which license a container job will use, decided before Gurobi starts

blocks.text: A logistics company runs Gurobi jobs in containers. Before a job starts Gurobi, it must decide which license it will use and log that decision, without logging any secret. Write `license_plan(environ, exists)`: `environ` is a dict of the job's environment variables, and `exists(path)` returns whether a file is there (passed in, so the tests need no files). Return a pair `(kind, detail)`, following these rules in order:

items: If all three of `WLSACCESSID`, `WLSSECRET` and `LICENSEID` are set (non-empty), return `("wls", {"WLSACCESSID": ..., "WLSSECRET": ..., "LICENSEID": <int>})`: Gurobi's `LICENSEID` parameter is a number.
If one or two of them are set, return `("error", "incomplete WLS key: <missing names> not set")`, naming the missing variables in the order above, joined by `", "`. Never put a value in the message.

If `GRB_LICENSE_FILE` is set, return `("file", <that path>)` if the file exists, otherwise `("error", "license file not found: <that path>")`. Gurobi does not look elsewhere when the variable names a missing file, so neither does this function.

Otherwise try Gurobi's default places on Linux, in this order: `/opt/gurobi/gurobi.lic`, then `<HOME>/gurobi.lic` with `HOME` from `environ` (skip it if `HOME` is not set). Return `("file", path)` for the first that exists.

blocks.text: No Gurobi license is needed. About twenty lines.

"""Run executes this file. Change the calls and see what prints. Submit grades."""
import logging

# Turn the logger up, so the `log.debug` lines of your code show under the printed lines.
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG, format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")

from license_plan import license_plan

# Made-up environments and a made-up file system; nothing here reads the real ones.
files = {"/opt/gurobi/gurobi.lic", "/srv/learner/gurobi.lic", "/mnt/keys/site.lic"}


def exists(path):
    return path in files


key = {"WLSACCESSID": "0000-demo", "WLSSECRET": "1111-demo", "LICENSEID": "1234"}
print("full WLS key:", license_plan(key, exists))
print("WLS key without secret:", license_plan({"WLSACCESSID": "0000-demo", "LICENSEID": "1234"}, exists))
print("GRB_LICENSE_FILE /mnt/keys/site.lic:", license_plan({"GRB_LICENSE_FILE": "/mnt/keys/site.lic"}, exists))
print("GRB_LICENSE_FILE /mnt/keys/gone.lic:", license_plan({"GRB_LICENSE_FILE": "/mnt/keys/gone.lic"}, exists))
print("HOME /srv/learner:", license_plan({"HOME": "/srv/learner"}, exists))
print("HOME /srv/learner, no /opt file:", license_plan({"HOME": "/srv/learner"}, lambda p: p == "/srv/learner/gurobi.lic"))

cases.says: all three WLS variables give ('wls', params) with the license id as an int
GRB_LICENSE_FILE naming an existing file gives ('file', that path)
GRB_LICENSE_FILE naming a missing file gives an error even when a default file exists
without the variable, /opt/gurobi/gurobi.lic is chosen before the home directory's file
one or two WLS variables give an error that names the missing ones and no value
